people.name: León Cortés Castro
people.nameZh: 萊昂·科爾特斯·卡斯特羅

body.zh-Hant: 萊昂·科爾特斯·卡斯特羅生於1882年12月8日，在聖荷西法學院取得法學學位。他的公職生涯始於軍事獨裁者費德里科·蒂諾科·格蘭納多斯（1917至1919年在任）任命他為阿拉胡埃拉衛戍區司令。哥斯大黎加國家圖書館系統的人物辭典另記他當過律師、阿拉胡埃拉省長、國家檔案館館長與太平洋鐵路管理人。
body.en: León Cortés Castro was born on 8 December 1882 and took a law degree at the School of Law in San José. His public career began when the military dictator Federico Tinoco Granados (1917–1919) appointed him commander of the Alajuela garrison. The Costa Rican national library system's biographical dictionary also lists him as a lawyer, governor of Alajuela, director of the National Archive and administrator of the Pacific Railway.

After receiving a law degree from the School of Law in San José

fue abogado, gobernador de la Alajuela

body.zh-Hant: 科爾特斯曾任國民議會議長（1925至1926年）、教育部長（1929至1930年），並在里卡多·希門尼斯·奧雷亞穆諾總統任內擔任公共工程部長（1930年及1932至1936年）。他在希門尼斯總統任內的公共工程部長任期鞏固了他務實、節儉的行政官聲譽，促使國家共和黨領導人在1936年推舉他為候選人。另據該國人物辭典，他在1932至1936年也任第三副位繼任人（tercer designado）。
body.en: Cortés served as president of the National Assembly (1925–1926) and as minister of education (1929–1930), and under President Ricardo Jiménez Oreamuno he was minister of public works (1930 and 1932–1936). His tour as minister of public works under Jiménez consolidated his reputation as a no-nonsense, frugal administrator, which led the leaders of the National Republican Party to choose him as their standard-bearer in 1936. The national biographical dictionary adds that he was also third designate to the presidency in 1932–1936.

body.zh-Hant: 科爾特斯在1936年2月9日當選總統，任期為1936年5月8日至1940年5月8日。據來源，他主張財政審慎，擴建全國公路網並推動大型營建計畫，也在1936年創立哥斯大黎加國家銀行。不過他任內介入1938年與1940年的選舉，使反對派候選人無法當選。
body.en: Cortés was elected president on 9 February 1936 and held office from 8 May 1936 to 8 May 1940. According to the source he championed fiscal responsibility, extended the national highway network and began an ambitious construction programme, and he founded the National Bank of Costa Rica in 1936. While president, however, he intervened in the 1938 and 1940 elections, preventing opposition candidates from being elected.

body.zh-Hant: 卡爾德隆·瓜迪亞就任後不久，科爾特斯作為反對勢力最主要的領袖公開與其決裂，另組對立政黨。1944年他在總統選舉中敗給特奧多羅·皮卡多·米查爾斯基。他一直是反對派領袖，直到1946年3月2日因心臟病突發驟逝。
body.en: Shortly after Rafael Ángel Calderón Guardia's inauguration, Cortés, as the most prominent leader of the opposition, openly broke with Calderón and formed a rival party. He lost the 1944 election to Teodoro Picado Michalski. He remained leader of the opposition until his sudden death from a heart attack on 2 March 1946.

heading.en: A civilian president and the 1925 election

body.zh-Hant: 米格爾·帕斯·巴拉奧納博士是國民黨（Nationalist Party）的文人黨員。1924年洪都拉斯爆發多股地方軍閥之間的血腥內戰，1925年他在自由黨棄權的情況下幾乎全票當選總統；這場選舉標誌著該內戰的最後階段，使國內秩序逐步恢復。他的總統任期為1925至1929年。
body.en: Dr. Miguel Paz Baraona was a civilian member of the Nationalist Party. A bloody civil war between rival warlords had erupted in Honduras in 1924, and in 1925 he was elected president almost unanimously, the Liberals abstaining. His election marked the final phase of that war and gradually restored domestic tranquillity. He was president of Honduras from 1925 to 1929.

heading.en: Conditions in office and banana exports

body.zh-Hant: 1925年費雷拉將軍領導了另一次小規模叛亂，但以洪都拉斯的標準來看，帕斯·巴拉奧納政府仍相當平靜。香蕉公司持續擴張，政府預算狀況改善，勞工組織活動也有所增加。和平讓香蕉公司得以恢復擴張，數年內使洪都拉斯成為世界首要的香蕉出口國。
body.en: Despite another minor uprising led by General Ferrera in 1925, Paz Barahona's administration was, by Honduran standards, rather tranquil. The banana companies continued to expand, the government's budgetary situation improved, and labour organizing even increased. Peace enabled the banana companies to resume their expansion, which within a few years made Honduras the world's premier banana exporter.

heading.zh-Hant: 與英國債權人的債務協議

body.zh-Hant: 帕斯與英國債券持有人協會談成減免並償還國家沉重外債的萊爾計畫（Lyall Plan）。經過多年談判，政府終於與英國債券持有人達成協議，清償大部分龐大的國債：債券按面額的20%、分30年贖回，積欠利息一筆勾銷，新利息只在協議最後15年計算。依此協議，洪都拉斯看似終於走上財政償付能力之路。
body.en: Paz negotiated the Lyall Plan with the British bondholders' association to reduce and repay the country's crippling foreign debt. After years of negotiations the government concluded an agreement with the British bondholders to liquidate most of the immense national debt: the bonds were to be redeemed at 20 percent of face value over thirty years, back interest was forgiven, and new interest accrued only over the last fifteen years. Under it Honduras at last seemed on the road to fiscal solvency.

body.zh-Hant: 佩德羅·內爾·奧斯皮納生於1858年9月18日，出生在波哥大的總統府，是總統馬里亞諾·奧斯皮納·羅德里格斯之子。他童年大半在瓜地馬拉度過，並取得加州大學的採礦工程學位。定居安蒂奧基亞後，他與兄弟共同經營以咖啡為主、也含採礦的家族事業；1892年當選國會議員，與保守黨的歷史派結盟。
body.en: Pedro Nel Ospina was born on 18 September 1858 in Bogotá's presidential palace, the son of President Mariano Ospina Rodríguez. He spent much of his childhood in Guatemala and took a degree in mining engineering from the University of California. Settling in Antioquia, he joined his brothers in running the family businesses, centred on coffee but including mining. Elected to Congress in 1892, he allied himself with the Historical wing of the Conservative Party.

heading.zh-Hant: 千日戰爭、戰爭部長與流亡
heading.en: War of the Thousand Days, war minister and exile

body.zh-Hant: 奧斯皮納在千日戰爭中擔任保守黨方面的指揮官。1901年副總統何塞·曼努埃爾·馬羅金任命他為戰爭部長，馬羅金此前已從總統曼努埃爾·桑克萊門特手中奪權；國防部歷任名單記他任職於1901年7月至9月。他因參與一次恢復桑克萊門特的未遂陰謀而被放逐，流亡期間在墨西哥、美國與歐洲研究棉花種植與紡織製造；他後來是該國第一座現代紡織廠的創辦人之一，該廠1906年設於麥德林附近。
body.en: Ospina served as a Conservative commander in the War of the Thousand Days. In 1901 Vice President José Manuel Marroquín, who had seized power from President Manuel A. Sanclemente, named him minister of war; the Ministry of Defence's list of ministers records his tenure as July to September 1901. His part in an abortive plot to restore Sanclemente led to his banishment, and in exile he studied cotton cultivation and textile manufacturing in Mexico, the United States and Europe. He was later a founder of the country's first modern textile factory, set up near Medellín in 1906.

heading.en: The 1922 election and the Kemmerer reforms

body.zh-Hant: 1922年總統選舉中，奧斯皮納擊敗自由黨的貝尼哈明·埃雷拉。據來源，他任內最重要的成就是採納埃德溫·凱默勒在1923年來哥倫比亞六個月所建議的銀行與財政改革，內容包括設立中央銀行共和國銀行（Banco de la República）、預算程序現代化，以及設立國家審計長一職。
body.en: In the presidential race of 1922 Ospina defeated the Liberal Benjamín Herrera. According to the source, the most important achievement of his administration was the adoption of the banking and fiscal reforms recommended by Edwin W. Kemmerer, who spent six months in Colombia in 1923. The reforms included a central bank, the Banco de la República, modernization of the budgeting process, and the creation of the office of national comptroller.

body.zh-Hant: 來源稱奧斯皮納是保守黨領袖，並任哥倫比亞總統（1922至1926年）。他是經濟史學者路易斯·奧斯皮納·巴斯克斯（1905至1977年）的父親，於1927年7月1日去世。
body.en: The source calls Ospina a Conservative Party leader and president of Colombia (1922–1926). He was the father of the economic historian Luis Ospina Vásquez (1905–1977) and died on 1 July 1927.
